display_name: ROBOTIS Dynamixel XL-330 — our refit of BAM's M6 on Rhoban's public bench logs
fit: python -m bam.process --raw data_raw_2 --logdir processed --dt 0.005; python -m bam.fit --actuator xl330 --model m6 --trials 5000 --workers 1 (optuna 4.9.0 CmaEsSampler bipop); position MAE 0.0202 rad on the 358 logs vs 0.0272 for the shipped v1.0.2 point (record bam-xl330-refit-2026-09-05)
license: Apache-2.0 (code); the bench logs' licence is unstated on the HF bucket — this bundle redistributes fitted numbers only
citation: Duclusaud, M., Passault, G., Padois, V., Ly, O. (2025). Extended Friction Models for the Physics Simulation of Servo Actuators. ICRA 2025, pp. 12091-12097. Refit and bootstrap: this repository, docs/e2e-research/72.
vendored_via: tools/bam-bootstrap.py and bam.fit on Rhoban's public logs, on an Apple M1 Pro
notes: The point is OUR refit, not Rhoban's shipped fit (robots/actuators/xl330 wraps that one). The uncertainty section, when present, is a block bootstrap over the public logs: log-sampling variability on one unit and one bench, not unit-to-unit spread. See docs/e2e-research/72.
